title: Arbitrary coefficient comparison of fixed normalized section complexes
statement: Let f:Y->X be a scheme morphism, U,V opens of X, and Uprime,Vprime opens of Y with Uprime=f^(-1)U and Vprime=f^(-1)V. Let k:Uprime intersection Vprime->U intersection V commute with the open inclusions and f. Let F and G be abelian etale sheaves on X and Y, phi:f^*F->G any morphism [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], I,J injective resolutions of F,G [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and cI,cJ prescribed normalized section-homology comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. There is a morphism alpha between their section short complexes [def-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris-section-complex] on U,V and Uprime,Vprime. In every degree the whole-scheme homology map, conjugated by cI and cJ, is H.map(phi) after cohomologyMap(f). The intersection homology map, conjugated by the prescribed open comparisons, is H.map(openSquareCoefficient(f,the intersection inclusions,k,the square,F,G,phi)) after cohomologyMap(k) [lem-weil-pbc-etale-limit-open-cohomology-cocone]. There is no cover assumption, no exactness conclusion, no connecting map, and no existential choice of comparisons.

source.place: Tag 0A50, injective-resolution section proof and coefficient functoriality, read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A50; Tag 01F7, resolution functoriality, read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01F7. Fixed normalized-comparison specialization written by S3.

proof.text: Substitute hU and hV. Cancel the monomorphism (U intersection V).iota in hk to identify k with morphismRestrict f (U intersection V). Adjoint phi to psi:F->f_*G. Exactness of upperStar, already supplied by the inverse-image definition module, lets adj.map_injective prove injectivity of every term of f_*J. Extend psi followed by the augmentation across I.ι in degree zero using Injective.factorThru. Use I.exact₀.descToInjective and I.exact_succ.descToInjective for the successive extensions; CochainComplex.mkHom packages these into beta with the augmentation equality. Apply resolutionSectionShortComplexTransfer to beta. This is the proved local helper exists_lift_to_injective_complex, adapted from the library’s existing construction.

Apply resolutionSection_canonical_coefficient_transfer to beta, psi and its augmentation equality. The adjunction equivalence cancels its inverse, so the coefficient morphism in the conclusion is the original phi. The first component of the explicit short-complex transfer is globalResolutionSectionTransfer.

For a section cycle on an open W use the inverse of sectionsEquiv to construct its Hom cocycle; sectionsEquiv_naturality and iCycles_d prove closure. Adjoint beta degreewise to e:f^*I->J. Its augmentation equation lifts the adjoint of psi. Apply exactFunctor_resolution_cocycle to compute the transported Ext class followed by that coefficient morphism. Precompose with etaleOpenFreeSheafPullback. Naturality of the adjunction unit and sectionsEquiv identifies this representing cocycle with the transfer of the original section. This is the proved local helper coefficient_transfer_ext, generalizing the library’s pure-pullback cocycle calculation without new assumptions.

Every homology class lifts along the epimorphism homologyπ. Apply homologyπ_naturality and the open_cocycle fields of the prescribed comparisons to its source and transferred cycles. The preceding Ext calculation identifies their Ext classes. Coefficient naturality of etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap follows by unfolding its definition, mapExactFunctor_comp, mapExactFunctor_mk₀ and Ext associativity. Then etaleOpenObjectCohomologyMap_pullback identifies the remaining pullback class. This proves coefficient_transfer_open for every W, q and class. Apply it to W=U intersection V. Expand openCohomologyPullback and openSquareCoefficient and use Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply: the two inverse-image composition comparisons and the restricted coefficient morphism agree, with proof irrelevance identifying the square proofs.

proof_origin.place: N4 Lean proof of the fixed normalized coefficient comparison, following Tag 0A50 section complexes; Tag 01F7, Remark 20.14.2, augmented comparisons; Tags 01FB and 03F3, cocycle transport and localization. lean.statement: theorem etaleSectionShortComplex_coefficient_comparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (U V : X.Opens) (U' V' : Y.Opens) (hU : U' = f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hV : V' = f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (k : (U' ⊓ V').toScheme ⟶ (U ⊓ V).toScheme) (hk : (U' ⊓ V').ι ≫ f = k ≫ (U ⊓ V).ι) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (G : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (φ : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj F ⟶ G) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (J : InjectiveResolution G) (cI : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison F I) (cJ : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G J) : ∃ α : etaleSectionShortComplex U V I.cocomplex ⟶ etaleSectionShortComplex U' V' J.cocomplex, (∀ (q : ℕ) (x : (etaleSectionShortComplex U V I.cocomplex).X₁.homology q), cJ.globalEquiv q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap α.τ₁ q x) = Sheaf.H.map φ q (cohomologyMap f F q (cI.globalEquiv q x))) ∧ (∀ (q : ℕ) (x : (etaleSectionShortComplex U V I.cocomplex).X₃.homology q), cJ.openEquiv (U' ⊓ V') q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap α.τ₃ q x) = Sheaf.H.map (openSquareCoefficient f (U ⊓ V).ι (U' ⊓ V').ι k hk F G φ) q (cohomologyMap k ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (U ⊓ V).ι).obj F) q (cI.openEquiv (U ⊓ V) q x)))
